episodes.title: Pathway International Tragedy: How Do Cults Gain Control? | All Angles Part 1 (2021) | TVJ News
episodes.description:
Following the deadly incident at Pathway International Kingdom in Albion, St. James, in October 2021, questions emerged about the organisation, its practices and the warning signs associated with cult-like groups.

In Part 1 of this October 2021 edition of All Angles, host Dionne Jackson Miller speaks with a psychologist about what defines a cult, why people can become involved, and how charismatic leaders can gain extraordinary influence over their followers.

The discussion explores the psychological need for belonging and certainty, the demands of total obedience, isolation from family and friends, financial control and other potential warning signs.

They also discuss why cult-like behaviour is not necessarily limited to religious organisations, how similar dynamics can appear in gangs and other groups, and what family members and friends can do when someone they care about appears to be trapped in such an organisation.

This episode originally aired on TVJ’s All Angles in October 2021.
